title: Celebrities and Sunday night at the Grand Terrace
summary: Movie stars visited; Sunday was party night.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: A lot of celebrities used to come out to the Grand Terrace, didn't they?
Tell me about some of those people, what they'd do, you know, or how they all like the band?
Yeah, they'd just sit and listen to the band and watch the show, and enjoy the show. And, you
know, we'd introduce them. They wouldn't do anything.
Yeah, like Leon Parr, George Raft, oh, the stars, you know, that was stars back in them days. All of them, when they come to Chicago, they'd come by the Grand Terrace.
There was also something that I read in the Earl Hines book, that Sunday was called celebrity night.
Everybody, entertainers and -- what do you call them, men about town --
Yeah. Everybody would come on Sunday night. That was a special night.
Well, what happened on those special nights?
Nothing, just the same thing. Drinking.
